d: Watch the match highlights and all goals from Croatia vs Panama in Group L of the FIFA World Cup 2026 at Toronto Stadium in Toronto, Canada. After a goalless first half in which Panama hit the crossbar, halftime substitute Ante Budimir broke the deadlock in the 54th minute off a Josip Stanišić delivery while captain Luka Modrić marked his 200th international appearance, helping Dominik Livaković and Croatia hold on for a vital 1-0 win.
